WikiCloneSources.description: Allow-list of upstream wikis. Key is the host; value holds the API endpoint and the human-facing article URL pattern ($1 = title). Nothing outside this list can ever be fetched.

WikiCloneDefaultSource.description: Host used when the directive names a bare page title instead of a full URL. Null means: use the only configured source.

WikiCloneNamespaceName.description: Display name for the shadow namespace, e.g. "Wikipedie". Null keeps the built-in "WikiClone".

WikiCloneStripClasses.description: CSS classes whose elements are dropped from the fetched article: edit links, print furniture, maintenance banners, navigation templates. These names are local to each upstream wiki — cs.wikipedia calls its navigation template "navbox2". Empty falls back to the built-in list.

WikiCloneSearchByDefault.description: Include the shadow namespace in the wiki's default search. The namespace is deliberately non-content so cloned pages do not inflate {{NUMBEROFARTICLES}}, but that would also drop it out of search — this puts it back.

WikiCloneContact.description: Contact address embedded in the outgoing User-Agent. Wikimedia's User-Agent policy requires one; syncing refuses to run without it.

WikiCloneRequestTimeout.description: Per-request timeout in seconds when talking to the upstream API.

WikiCloneMaxLag.description: Value of the maxlag API parameter. Politeness setting for Wikimedia wikis; see https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:Maxlag_parameter

WikiCloneSyncUser.description: Name of the system account that owns shadow-page edits. Created on demand.
